1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:26px 26px;border:1px solid rgba(255,124,140,.22);box-shadow:0 80px 100px -50px #000;}
  .vl-tw-o{position:absolute;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:opacity .45s,filter .45s;}

  .vl-tw-hs{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;}

  .vl-tw-hs[data-o="personas"]{left:54%;top:11%;transform:translateZ(132px) rotateZ(37deg) rotateX(-59deg);}
  .vl-tw-hs[data-o="flotillas"]{left:56%;top:77%;transform:translateZ(28px) rotateZ(37deg) rotateX(-59deg);}

  .vl-tw[data-focus="personas"] .vl-tw-o:not([data-o="personas"]),
  .vl-tw[data-focus="flotillas"] .vl-tw-o:not([data-o="flotillas"]),

  /* ===== CW-T02-R5 · HOME GT · escena de operación reconocible + callouts 2D ===== */
  .vl-t5{position:relative;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #2a2833;background:radial-gradient(122% 100% at 20% -16%,#3b2434 0%,#1e1827 44%,#0B0A10 100%);aspect-ratio:16/11;min-height:392px;}

  .vl-t5-cam{position:absolute;inset:0;perspective:1450px;perspective-origin:50% 40%;transform-origin:50% 56%;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.72,.22,1);}
  .vl-t5-plate{position:absolute;left:50%;top:55%;width:78%;height:64%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(58deg) rotateZ(-34deg);transform-style:preserve-3d;border-radius:6px;background-color:#1C1727;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:24px 24px;border:1px solid rgba(255,124,140,.3);box-shadow:0 92px 120px -62px #000,inset 0 0 90px rgba(0,0,0,.42);}
  .vl-t5-sh{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(0,0,0,.85),rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%);filter:blur(7px);}
  .vl-t5-o{position:absolute;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:opacity .42s,filter .42s;}
  .vl-t5-o .top,.vl-t5-o .sa,.vl-t5-o .sb{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);}
  .vl-t5-o .top{inset:0;border-radius:2px;transform:translateZ(var(--h,28px));background:linear-gradient(142deg,rgba(255,236,240,.66),rgba(255,158,172,.28) 55%,rgba(255,255,255,.1));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
  .vl-t5-o .sa{left:0;top:100%;width:100%;height:var(--h,28px);transform-origin:top center;transform:rotateX(90deg);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(158,60,79,.97),rgba(20,11,16,.98));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);overflow:hidden;}
  .vl-t5-o .sb{left:100%;top:0;width:var(--h,28px);height:100%;transform-origin:left center;transform:rotateY(-90deg);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(88,32,45,.98),rgba(9,7,11,.99));box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14);overflow:hidden;}

  .t5-sp .sa::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;top:28%;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);box-shadow:0 8px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16);}
  /* programa: lectura de conjunto */
  .vl-t5-prog{position:absolute;left:-9%;top:-9%;width:118%;height:118%;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,124,140,.5);background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(228,0,43,.14),rgba(255,255,255,.05));box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(228,0,43,.2),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.07);transform:translateZ(300px);opacity:0;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.72,.22,1),opacity .5s;pointer-events:none;}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="programa"] .vl-t5-prog{opacity:1;transform:translateZ(190px);}
  .vl-t5-progbtn{position:absolute;right:14px;top:13px;z-index:7;min-height:44px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(10,9,13,.78);color:#F4F1EA;font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.01em;cursor:pointer;}
  .vl-t5-progbtn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#E4002B;border-color:#E4002B;color:#fff;}
  /* callouts 2D · desacoplados de la geometría */
  .vl-t5-tags{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;}
  .vl-t5-tag{position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;}
  .vl-t5-tag > button,.vl-t5-tag > span.pin{position:absolute;left:-22px;top:-22px;width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:0;border:none;background:transparent;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:inherit;}
  .vl-t5-tag > button{cursor:pointer;}
  .vl-t5-tag .dot{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#E4002B;border:3px solid #F4F1EA;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(228,0,43,.18),0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s;}
  .vl-t5-tag > button:hover .dot{transform:scale(1.18);box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(228,0,43,.26),0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.7);}
  .vl-t5-tag > button[aria-pressed="true"] .dot{background:#fff;border-color:#E4002B;box-shadow:0 0 0 11px rgba(228,0,43,.34),0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.7);}
  .vl-t5-tag .chip{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);white-space:nowrap;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#F4F1EA;background:rgba(8,7,11,.94);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 12px 24px -12px #000;}
  .vl-t5-tag.rt .chip{left:32px;}
  .vl-t5-tag.lt .chip{right:32px;}
  .vl-t5-tag.rt .chip::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-13px;top:50%;width:13px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);}
  .vl-t5-tag.lt .chip::before{content:'';position:absolute;right:-13px;top:50%;width:13px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);}
  .vl-t5-tag > button[aria-pressed="true"] ~ .chip{background:#E4002B;border-color:#E4002B;color:#fff;}
  .vl-t5-tag > button:focus-visible,.vl-t5-progbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FFD6DC;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:12px;}
  .vl-t5-tag > button:focus-visible .dot{transform:scale(1.18);}
  /* foco por exposición */
  .vl-t5[data-focus="patrimonio"] .vl-t5-cam{transform:scale(1.14) translate(9%,-5%);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="personas"] .vl-t5-cam{transform:scale(1.12) translate(-2%,6%);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="flotillas"] .vl-t5-cam{transform:scale(1.14) translate(-4%,-8%);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="continuidad"] .vl-t5-cam{transform:scale(1.15) translate(-15%,-5%);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="contratos"] .vl-t5-cam{transform:scale(1.15) translate(-13%,7%);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="rc"] .vl-t5-cam{transform:scale(1.03);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="patrimonio"] .vl-t5-o:not([data-o="patrimonio"]),
  .vl-t5[data-focus="personas"] .vl-t5-o:not([data-o="personas"]),
  .vl-t5[data-focus="flotillas"] .vl-t5-o:not([data-o="flotillas"]),
  .vl-t5[data-focus="continuidad"] .vl-t5-o:not([data-o="continuidad"]),
  .vl-t5[data-focus="contratos"] .vl-t5-o:not([data-o="contratos"]),
  .vl-t5[data-focus="rc"] .vl-t5-o:not([data-o="rc"]){opacity:.4;filter:brightness(.68) saturate(.4);}
  .vl-t5[data-focus="contratos"] .t5-sp{opacity:.7;}
  .vl-t5--mini{aspect-ratio:16/10;min-height:0;border-radius:16px;border-color:#332f3c;}
  .vl-t5--mini .vl-t5-lab{left:14px;top:12px;font-size:9px;}
  .vl-t5--mini .vl-t5-tag .chip{display:none;}
  @media(max-width:999px){
    .vl-t5{aspect-ratio:4/3;}
    .vl-t5 .vl-t5-cam{transform:none !important;}
  }
  @media(max-width:760px){
    .vl-t5-tag .chip{display:none;}
  }
  @media(max-width:620px){
    .vl-t5{aspect-ratio:1/1;min-height:268px;border-radius:18px;}
    .vl-t5-plate{width:88%;height:68%;}
    .vl-t5-progbtn{right:10px;top:10px;font-size:11px;padding:0 11px;}
  }
  /* ===== CW-T02-R5 · mini-escenas de objeto para los otros cinco estados ===== */
  .vl-s5{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:302px;perspective:1150px;perspective-origin:50% 36%;}
  .vl-s5-key{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-14%;width:78%;height:64%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(58% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(255,205,212,.26),transparent 72%);pointer-events:none;}
  .vl-s5-floor{position:absolute;left:-8%;right:-8%;bottom:1%;height:54%;transform:rotateX(68deg);background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,124,140,.15) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,124,140,.15) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:32px 32px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 40%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 40%,transparent);pointer-events:none;}
  .vl-s5-3d{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
  .vl-s5-b{position:absolute;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
  .vl-s5-b > .top,.vl-s5-b > .sa,.vl-s5-b > .sb{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);}
  .vl-s5-b > .top{inset:0;border-radius:3px;transform:translateZ(var(--h,24px));background:linear-gradient(142deg,rgba(255,236,240,.66),rgba(255,158,172,.26) 55%,rgba(255,255,255,.1));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.46),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.32);}
  .vl-s5-b > .sa{left:0;top:100%;width:100%;height:var(--h,24px);transform-origin:top center;transform:rotateX(90deg);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(156,58,76,.97),rgba(19,11,15,.98));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2);overflow:hidden;}
  .vl-s5-b > .sb{left:100%;top:0;width:var(--h,24px);height:100%;transform-origin:left center;transform:rotateY(-90deg);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(86,31,43,.98),rgba(9,7,11,.99));box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.13);overflow:hidden;}
  .vl-s5-sh{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(0,0,0,.8),rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%);filter:blur(6px);}
  .vl-s5-tag{position:absolute;z-index:4;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#F4F1EA;background:rgba(8,7,11,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 9px;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 12px 24px -12px #000;}
  .vl-s5-legend{display:grid;gap:9px;}
  .vl-s5-legend > div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:11px;align-items:start;border-top:1px solid #2a2833;padding-top:9px;}
  .vl-s5-legend .kn{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#FF9DA8;padding-top:3px;}
  .vl-s5-legend b{display:block;font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#F4F1EA;}
  .vl-s5-legend i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#B5AEA4;margin-top:3px;}
  /* personas y familias: auto, salud, vínculo */
  .s5-car{left:5%;top:50%;width:29%;height:15%;--h:21px;}
  .s5-car .top{background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(255,232,236,.52),rgba(255,255,255,.1));}
  .s5-carcab{left:9%;top:43%;width:12%;height:13%;--h:32px;}
  .s5-carcab .sa{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(186,214,255,.3),rgba(24,14,19,.95));}
  .s5-wl{position:absolute;width:4.5%;height:5%;border-radius:50%;background:#08070C;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);}
  .s5-cli{left:40%;top:22%;width:18%;height:21%;--h:90px;}
  .s5-cli .sa::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:44%;top:16%;width:12%;height:32%;background:rgba(255,232,236,.9);}
  .s5-cli .sa::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:34%;top:26%;width:32%;height:12%;background:rgba(255,232,236,.9);}
  .s5-cli .sb{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(68,25,35,.97),rgba(12,9,13,.98)),repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(186,214,255,.16) 0 10%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 10% 22%);background-blend-mode:normal,screen;}
  .s5-ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,150,164,.85);transform:translateZ(66px);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(228,0,43,.28);}
  .s5-ring1{left:65%;top:36%;width:13%;aspect-ratio:1;}
  .s5-ring2{left:72%;top:36%;width:13%;aspect-ratio:1;border-color:rgba(255,214,220,.7);}
  .s5-ring3{left:68.5%;top:47%;width:13%;aspect-ratio:1;border-color:rgba(228,0,43,.85);}
  /* cotizar o comparar: balanza de diferencias */
  .s5-col{left:46%;top:34%;width:7%;height:32%;--h:74px;}
  .s5-beam{position:absolute;left:16%;top:27%;width:68%;height:2.4%;border-radius:3px;transform:translateZ(98px) rotateZ(-4deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,180,190,.55),rgba(255,255,255,.3));box-shadow:0 18px 30px -18px #000;}
  .s5-tray{position:absolute;width:17%;height:5.5%;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,226,232,.34),rgba(255,255,255,.06));}
  .s5-tray.a{left:13%;top:37%;transform:translateZ(76px);}
  .s5-tray.b{right:13%;top:45%;transform:translateZ(58px);}
  .s5-hang{position:absolute;width:1px;background:rgba(255,214,220,.55);}
  .s5-hang.a{left:21.5%;top:29%;height:9%;transform:translateZ(86px);}
  .s5-hang.b{right:21.5%;top:31%;height:15%;transform:translateZ(68px);}
  .s5-blk{position:absolute;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(228,0,43,.4),rgba(255,255,255,.08));}
  .s5-blk.a1{left:15%;top:32%;width:5%;height:5%;transform:translateZ(82px);}
  .s5-blk.a2{left:21%;top:31%;width:5%;height:6%;transform:translateZ(82px);}
  .s5-blk.a3{left:15%;top:26%;width:5%;height:5%;transform:translateZ(82px);}
  .s5-blk.b1{right:15%;top:40%;width:5%;height:5%;transform:translateZ(64px);}
  .s5-blk.b2{right:21%;top:39%;width:5%;height:6%;transform:translateZ(64px);}
  .s5-rule{position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;bottom:14%;height:4%;border-radius:4px;transform:translateZ(16px);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,226,232,.28),rgba(255,255,255,.06));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);}
  .s5-rule::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:2%;right:2%;bottom:0;height:56%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,214,220,.6) 0 1px,rgba(0,0,0,0) 1px 16.6%);}
  /* revisar mis seguros: expediente, lupa y ciclo */
  .s5-fold{left:8%;top:52%;width:44%;height:20%;--h:9px;}
  .s5-fold .top{background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(255,232,236,.46),rgba(255,255,255,.08));}
  .s5-fold2{left:14%;top:38%;width:36%;height:16%;--h:5px;opacity:.85;}
  .s5-lines{position:absolute;left:12%;top:55%;width:36%;height:14%;transform:translateZ(11px);background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,214,220,.4) 0 1px,rgba(0,0,0,0) 1px 22%);}
  .s5-mag{position:absolute;left:28%;top:32%;width:17%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,232,236,.85);background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 28%,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.03));transform:translateZ(116px);box-shadow:0 24px 40px -20px #000;}
  .s5-maghd{position:absolute;left:43%;top:52%;width:16%;height:3%;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,232,236,.8),rgba(255,255,255,.2));transform:translateZ(104px) rotateZ(34deg);}
  .s5-dial{position:absolute;right:9%;top:20%;width:26%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,150,164,.55);transform:translateZ(72px);background:conic-gradient(from 200deg,rgba(228,0,43,.42) 0 34%,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 34% 100%);box-shadow:0 26px 44px -22px #000;}
  .s5-dial::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:calc(50% - 1px);top:12%;width:2px;height:38%;background:#FFD6DC;transform-origin:bottom center;transform:rotateZ(56deg);}
  /* siniestro o asistencia: prioridad y canal */
  .s5-cone{position:absolute;left:14%;top:30%;width:15%;height:30%;transform:translateZ(66px);clip-path:polygon(50% 0,88% 100%,12% 100%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FF6A7C,#A6122A);}
  .s5-cone::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.72) 0 8%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 8% 26%);opacity:.55;}
  .s5-conebase{left:12%;top:57%;width:19%;height:7%;--h:5px;}
  .s5-bring{position:absolute;left:21%;top:62%;width:36%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(70deg);border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(228,0,43,.55);box-shadow:0 0 60px 10px rgba(228,0,43,.18);}
  .s5-post{left:52%;top:40%;width:7%;height:9%;--h:96px;}
  .s5-hset{position:absolute;left:50%;top:30%;width:15%;height:5%;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,232,236,.9),rgba(255,255,255,.28));transform:translateZ(104px);box-shadow:0 16px 26px -14px #000;}
  .s5-bar{left:66%;top:52%;width:26%;height:4%;--h:34px;}
  .s5-bar .sa{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#E4002B 0 12%,rgba(255,232,236,.9) 12% 24%);}
  /* soy cliente: mostrador y archivador de gestiones */
  .s5-cnt{left:6%;top:52%;width:50%;height:17%;--h:38px;}
  .s5-cnt .sa::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;top:34%;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
  .s5-tray2{left:12%;top:44%;width:15%;height:7%;--h:7px;}
  .s5-tray3{left:30%;top:44%;width:15%;height:7%;--h:11px;}
  .s5-cab{right:8%;top:22%;width:25%;height:25%;--h:96px;}
  .s5-cab .sa{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(96,40,54,.96),rgba(20,12,17,.97)),repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,232,236,.22) 0 2px,rgba(0,0,0,0) 2px 25%);background-blend-mode:normal,screen;}
  .s5-cab .sa::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:42%;top:9%;width:16%;height:3px;background:rgba(255,232,236,.6);box-shadow:0 24px 0 rgba(255,232,236,.6),0 48px 0 rgba(255,232,236,.6),0 72px 0 rgba(255,232,236,.6);}
  @media(max-width:760px){
    .vl-s5{min-height:210px;perspective:900px;}
    .vl-s5-tag{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:5px 7px;white-space:normal;max-width:46%;}
  }
  @media(max-width:400px){ .vl-s5{min-height:178px;} .vl-s5-tag{display:none;} }
  /* ===== CW-T02-R6 · HOME GT · jerarquía P0/P1, P2 subordinada, lectura semántica permanente ===== */
  .vl-t6-leg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:16px;}
  .vl-t6-leg button{text-align:left;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid #35323d;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;min-height:64px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;align-items:start;transition:border-color .16s,background .16s;}
  .vl-t6-leg button:hover{border-color:#7d5560;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  .vl-t6-leg button[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#E4002B;background:rgba(228,0,43,.13);}
  .vl-t6-leg button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FFD6DC;outline-offset:2px;}
  .vl-t6-leg .kn{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#FF9DA8;padding-top:3px;}
  .vl-t6-leg b{display:block;font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#fff;}
  .vl-t6-leg i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#B5AEA4;margin-top:3px;}
  .vl-t6-sub{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #2a2833;}
  .vl-t6-sub p{margin:0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#A9A29A;max-width:58ch;}
  .vl-t6-sublink{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:none;border:none;padding:0;font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#CFC9BE;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;cursor:pointer;}
  .vl-t6-sublink:hover{color:#fff;}
  .vl-t6-sublink[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#FF9DA8;}
  .vl-t6-sublink:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FFD6DC;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px;}
  @media(max-width:760px){ .vl-t6-leg{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media(max-width:480px){ .vl-t6-leg{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  /* ===== F7-CIG-02 · HOME GT V2 · ancla humana P02, contexto GT subordinado, secuencia del método ===== */
  .vl-v2-hum{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;height:clamp(268px,32vh,392px);border-radius:22px 0 0 22px;border:1px solid #3a3646;border-right:none;margin-right:calc(-1 * clamp(20px,3vw,44px));box-shadow:0 52px 96px -56px #000;background:#0B0A0E;}
  .vl-v2-hum img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:52% 24%;display:block;}
  .vl-v2-hum .scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(184deg,rgba(11,10,14,0) 30%,rgba(11,10,14,.6) 72%,rgba(11,10,14,.96));}
  .vl-v2-hum figcaption{position:absolute;left:clamp(16px,1.6vw,22px);right:clamp(16px,1.6vw,22px);bottom:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
  .vl-v2-hum figcaption .kk{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#FF9DA8;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.9);}
  .vl-v2-hum figcaption b{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(15px,1.15vw,17px);line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.9);}
  .vl-v2-hum figcaption i{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#E7E0D5;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.95);max-width:52ch;}
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    .vl-gt-hero{grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;}
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-r4-copy{grid-column:1;grid-row:1 / span 2;}
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-v2-hum{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;}
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-r4-right{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;min-width:0;}
    .vl-r4-ph{height:clamp(128px,15vh,178px);border-radius:0;}
    .vl-r4-canvas{margin-top:-32px;}
  }
  @media(max-width:1319px){
    .vl-v2-hum{height:clamp(210px,30vh,296px);border-radius:20px;border-right:1px solid #3a3646;margin-right:0;margin-top:20px;z-index:1;}
  }
  @media(max-width:520px){ .vl-v2-hum figcaption i{padding-right:64px;} }
  /* controles: afordancia por contraste real, no por hover (R6 blocker) */
  .vl-gt-intent{border-color:#6A6478;}
  .vl-t6-leg button{border-color:#6A6478;}
  .vl-t6-sublink{color:#DED8CD;}
  /* método A&S · secuencia viva */
  .vl-v2-seq{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));margin-top:34px;}
  .vl-v2-seq::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:13px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E4002B,rgba(228,0,43,.16));}
  .vl-v2-step{position:relative;padding-right:clamp(16px,2vw,32px);}
  .vl-v2-step .nn{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#E4002B;color:#fff;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .vl-v2-step h4{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(19px,1.5vw,23px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.06;margin:16px 0 0;color:#fff;}
  .vl-v2-step > p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#CFC9BE;margin:9px 0 0;}
  .vl-v2-io{margin-top:14px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid #3a3646;display:grid;gap:7px;}
  .vl-v2-io span{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#B5AEA4;display:flex;gap:9px;}
  .vl-v2-io em{font-style:normal;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#FF9DA8;flex:none;width:40px;padding-top:2px;}
  @media(max-width:1023px){
    .vl-v2-seq{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;row-gap:28px;column-gap:clamp(14px,2.4vw,26px);}
    .vl-v2-seq::before{display:none;}
    .vl-v2-step{border-top:2px solid #E4002B;padding-top:14px;padding-right:0;}
  }
  @media(max-width:560px){ .vl-v2-seq{grid-template-columns:1fr;row-gap:22px;} }
  /* flotillas · ruta como explicación visual + necesidad con criterio */
  .vl-v2-fleet{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:clamp(22px,3vw,46px);margin-top:28px;align-items:start;}
  .vl-v2-route{position:relative;display:grid;min-width:0;}
  .vl-v2-route::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:13px;top:16px;bottom:18px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#C4001F,rgba(196,0,31,.18));}
  .vl-v2-rst{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr);gap:15px;padding-bottom:24px;}
  .vl-v2-rst:last-child{padding-bottom:0;}
  .vl-v2-rst .mk{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid #C4001F;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:#C4001F;}
  .vl-v2-rst h4{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:3px 0 0;color:#12110F;}
  .vl-v2-rst p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#454039;}
  .vl-v2-need{display:grid;gap:10px;min-width:0;}
  .vl-v2-need button{text-align:left;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;border:1px solid #CFC5B4;border-radius:14px;padding:15px 18px;min-height:72px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:15px;align-items:start;transition:border-color .16s,transform .16s;}
  .vl-v2-need button:hover{border-color:#E4002B;transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .vl-v2-need button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #C4001F;outline-offset:2px;}
  .vl-v2-need .kn{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#C4001F;padding-top:4px;}
  .vl-v2-need b{display:block;font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.012em;color:#12110F;}
  .vl-v2-need i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#454039;margin-top:4px;}
  .vl-v2-need u{display:block;text-decoration:none;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1.5;color:#6E655C;margin-top:9px;}
  @media(max-width:1023px){ .vl-v2-fleet{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  /* enriquecimiento · objeción contextual */
  .vl-v2-obj{margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #3a3646;padding-top:12px;}
  .vl-v2-obj .kk{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#A9A29A;}
  .vl-v2-obj q{display:block;quotes:none;font-family:'Instrument Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;color:#EFE9DD;margin:7px 0 0;}
  .vl-v2-obj p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#CFC9BE;}
  /* personas · por qué importa */
  .vl-v2-why{display:block;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#8C8378;margin-top:8px;}
  /* F7-CIG-04-R1 · GT-B · franja de momentos del traslado (preview, sin diagnóstico) */
  .vl-v2-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(10px,1.6vw,18px);margin-top:26px;}
  .vl-v2-striti{border-top:2px solid #C4001F;padding-top:12px;display:grid;gap:5px;min-width:0;}
  .vl-v2-striti span{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#C4001F;}
  .vl-v2-striti b{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,18px);letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#12110F;line-height:1.14;}
  @media(max-width:560px){ .vl-v2-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;} }
  /* F7-CIG-04-R1 · GT-A · dimensiones de amplitud (preview, no diagnóstico) */
  .vl-v2-dims{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:20px;}
  .vl-v2-dim{border-top:1px solid #2a2833;padding-top:11px;display:grid;gap:4px;}
  .vl-v2-dim:first-child{border-top:2px solid #E4002B;}
  .vl-v2-dim b{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;letter-spacing:-.012em;color:#fff;}
  .vl-v2-dim i{font-style:normal;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#CFC9BE;}
  /* ===== F7-CIG-02-R2 · REPAIR A · TIER-A HUMAN-LED OPENING en 1024 / 820 / 390 / 360 ===== */
  /* P09 deja de ser paisaje dominante bajo 1320: pasa a franja de contexto en flujo normal. */
  @media(max-width:1319px){
    .vl-r4-ph{position:static !important;left:auto !important;right:auto !important;top:auto !important;
      height:clamp(94px,12vh,132px) !important;margin:0 !important;border:1px solid #2f2c39 !important;
      border-radius:14px !important;z-index:auto !important;
      -webkit-mask-image:none !important;mask-image:none !important;}
    .vl-r4-ph img{opacity:1 !important;object-position:50% 54% !important;}
    .vl-r4-ph .scrim{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,13,16,0) 34%,rgba(14,13,16,.68)) !important;}
    .vl-r4-ph figcaption{display:block !important;font-size:9px !important;letter-spacing:.12em;left:14px;bottom:10px;}
    .vl-r4-canvas{margin-top:16px !important;}
    .vl-v2-hum{margin-top:0;}
  }
  /* 1024–1319 · split: copy a la izquierda, ancla humana a la derecha, escena debajo a todo el ancho. */
  @media(min-width:1024px) and (max-width:1319px){
    .vl-gt-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,.9fr) !important;
      grid-template-rows:auto auto;align-items:start;}
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-r4-copy{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;}
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-v2-hum{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;height:clamp(292px,44vh,412px);
      border-radius:20px 0 0 20px;border-right:none;
      margin-right:calc(-1 * clamp(20px,3vw,44px));}
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-r4-right{grid-column:1 / -1;grid-row:2;min-width:0;}
  }
  /* ≤1023 (820, 390, 360) · el ancla humana abre, antes del H1; el router sigue temprano.
     El pie deja de superponerse a los rostros y la caja deja de ser una franja: la relación de
     aspecto se acerca a la del master (1.22:1) para no recortar a los sujetos. */
  @media(max-width:1023px){
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-v2-hum{order:-1;height:auto;min-height:0;overflow:visible;
      background:transparent;border:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;margin-right:0;
      display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.53fr) minmax(0,.47fr);
      gap:clamp(14px,2vw,20px);align-items:center;}
    .vl-v2-hum img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1.34/1;object-position:52% 30%;
      border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #3a3646;box-shadow:0 34px 64px -44px #000;}
    .vl-v2-hum .scrim{display:none;}
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption{position:static;left:auto;right:auto;bottom:auto;gap:6px;padding:0;}
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption .kk,
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption b,
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption i{text-shadow:none;}
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption i{max-width:38ch;}
    .vl-gt-hero h1{margin-top:16px;}
  }
  /* ≤560 · una columna: imagen arriba con la altura suficiente, pie debajo. */
  @media(max-width:560px){
    .vl-gt-hero > .vl-v2-hum{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;}
    .vl-v2-hum img{aspect-ratio:1.55/1;object-position:52% 32%;}
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption b{font-size:15px;}
    .vl-v2-hum figcaption i{font-size:12px;max-width:46ch;padding-right:0;}
    .vl-r4-ph{height:clamp(84px,11vh,108px) !important;}
  }
  /* ===== F7-CIG-02-R2 · REPAIR C · safe-area local de Alys en Home GT ===== */
  @media(max-width:620px){
    .vl-gt-note{padding-right:76px !important;}
    .vl-gt-hero .vl-gt-cta-row{padding-right:64px;}
  }
  /* ===== F7-CIG-02-R5 · safe rail del Need Router completo frente al FAB de Alys.
     Sustituye el corredor de R4, que reservaba espacio solo al último control: con distintas alturas
     de viewport el FAB fijo puede coincidir con cualquier control de la columna derecha, no solo con
     el sexto. La reserva pasa al contenedor, de modo que protege los seis journeys y mantiene las dos
     columnas simétricas. Alys no se mueve, no se oculta y su comportamiento global no cambia. */
  @media(max-width:660px){
    .vl-gt-intents{
      padding-right:calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
    }
  }
  @media(min-width:661px) and (max-width:1023px){
    .vl-gt-intents{
      padding-right:calc(128px + env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
    }
  }
  .vl-gt-tail{padding-bottom:calc(94px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) !important;}
  @media(min-width:1320px){ .vl-gt-tail{padding-bottom:calc(112px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) !important;} }
  @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .vl-t5-cam,.vl-t5-prog,.vl-t5-o,.vl-t5-tag .dot{transition:none !important;}
  }


  /* ===== F7-CIG-05-R1B · HOME GT + HOME CO · compactación de ritmo y jerarquía A/B/C/D =====
     Alcance: solo layouts de Home GT y Home CO. Nivel A hero intacto; Nivel B un solo preview
     estratégico por Home (360–460px desktop); Nivel C teasers; Nivel D banda utilitaria. */
  @media(min-width:1000px){ .vl-r1b-twin{aspect-ratio:auto;height:clamp(360px,30vw,440px);min-height:0;} }
  @media(max-width:999px){ .vl-r1b-twin{aspect-ratio:16/10;} }
  @media(min-width:668px) and (max-width:999px){ .vl-r1b-twin{min-height:0;} }
  /* ===== F7-CIG-05-R2 · R1B-RSP-01 · GT twin horizontal clipping repair (CSS-only) ===== */
  @media(max-width:667px){ .vl-r1b-twin{aspect-ratio:4/3;} }
  @media(max-width:620px){ .vl-r1b-twin{aspect-ratio:1/1;width:100%;max-width:100%;} }

  /* ===== F7-CIG-05-R3 · Home GT Hero · escena de orientación empresarial (sustituye al twin del Hero) =====
     Alcance: solo la escena gtIsEmpresa del Hero GT. Visual de apoyo, subordinado al twin completo de GT-02. */
  .vl-gt-orient{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0;padding:clamp(14px,1.7vw,20px) clamp(12px,1.5vw,18px);border:1px solid #332f3c;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055),rgba(255,255,255,.015));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05);}
  .vl-gt-orient-core{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#F4F1EA;border:1px solid rgba(228,0,43,.55);background:rgba(228,0,43,.14);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 16px;}
  .vl-gt-orient-stem{width:1px;height:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E4002B,rgba(228,0,43,.28));}
  .vl-gt-orient-rail{width:100%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(228,0,43,.06),rgba(228,0,43,.55),rgba(228,0,43,.06));}
  .vl-gt-orient-sigs{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;}
  .vl-gt-sig{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;text-align:center;}
  .vl-gt-sig::before{content:'';width:1px;height:12px;background:rgba(228,0,43,.5);flex:none;}
  .vl-gt-sig b{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#EFE9DD;text-wrap:pretty;}
  @media(max-width:760px){
    .vl-gt-orient-rail{display:none;}
    .vl-gt-orient-sigs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px 12px;}
    .vl-gt-sig{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-align:left;border-top:1px solid #2a2833;padding-top:9px;}
    .vl-gt-sig::before{width:14px;height:1px;}
  }
  .vl-r1b-teaser .vl-v2-strip{margin-top:16px;}
  .vl-r1b-teaser .vl-co-groups{margin-top:18px;}
  .vl-r1b-seq{margin-top:18px;}

  /* ===== F7-T3B-R3 · EMPRESAS CO · biblioteca V3 + consola de producto (owner rework 2026-09-07) ·
     reglas CO-scoped salvo la capa visual del footer, reabierta por el owner ===== */
  /* HERO CO · una pieza editorial de biblioteca + banda de seis áreas integrada */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{min-width:0;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia img{aspect-ratio:19/20;object-position:100% 50%;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heropanel{background:transparent !important;border:none !important;border-top:1px solid #2a2833 !important;border-radius:0 !important;padding:clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px) 0 0 !important;box-shadow:none !important;}
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.04fr) minmax(0,.96fr) !important;align-items:start !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heropanel{grid-column:1 / -1;margin-top:clamp(16px,1.8vw,28px);}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{max-width:560px;justify-self:end;}
  }
  @media(min-width:1025px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-areas{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;} }
  @media(max-width:1319px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{max-width:600px;} }
  @media(min-width:661px) and (max-width:1319px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{width:min(100%,600px);justify-self:center;} }
  @media(max-width:660px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{max-width:100%;} [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia img{aspect-ratio:4/5;} }

  /* CONSOLA DE EXPLORACIÓN · barra de operación + fila contextual + taller (CO) */
  .vl-mapa-work{display:contents;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-tabs{margin-top:20px !important;padding:12px 14px !important;border-top:none !important;background:#0E0D10;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;align-items:center;gap:8px !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-tabs::before{color:#FF9DA8 !important;flex:0 0 auto !important;margin:0 8px 0 2px !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-tabs button{min-height:44px !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#E4002B !important;border-color:#E4002B !important;color:#fff !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-role{background:#FBF8F2;border:1px solid #E2DACF !important;border-top:none !important;border-radius:0 !important;padding:14px 16px !important;margin:0 !important;}
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr);align-items:start;border:1px solid #E2DACF;border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 20px 20px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F8F4ED 0 46%,#fff 46% 100%);}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-emp-m03{max-width:100% !important;margin:18px !important;border-radius:16px !important;position:sticky;top:101px;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-split{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;margin:0 !important;gap:0 !important;border-left:1px solid #E2DACF !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-split > div{background:transparent !important;border:none !important;border-radius:0 !important;box-shadow:none !important;padding:clamp(18px,1.9vw,26px) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-ws{border-top:1px solid #E7E2D6 !important;padding:0 !important;gap:0 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper{background:transparent !important;border:none !important;border-radius:0 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-act{border-radius:0 !important;}
  }
  @media(min-width:721px) and (max-width:1319px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-m03{max-width:100% !important;margin:0 !important;border-radius:0 0 20px 20px !important;}
  }
  /* 03 · mockup de comparación */
  @media(max-width:420px){
    .vl-comp-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) !important;padding-left:9px !important;padding-right:9px !important;}
    .vl-comp-row span{font-size:11.5px !important;}
  }
  /* banda de continuidad */
  @media(max-width:1024px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-cont{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;} }

  /* ===== FOOTER GLOBAL · tres capas (marca/acción · navegación/contacto · legal/país).
     Solo capa visual: navegación, canales, textos país/legal y release gates sin cambios. ===== */
  footer .vl-foot-legal{margin:0 auto !important;padding-top:0 !important;border-top:none !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-col > div:first-child{color:#FF9DA8 !important;font-size:10.5px !important;letter-spacing:.18em !important;border-bottom:1px solid #322e39 !important;padding-bottom:10px !important;margin-bottom:12px !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-brand > div:first-child{border-bottom:none !important;padding-bottom:0 !important;margin-bottom:0 !important;}
  footer .vl-flink{color:#EDE9E0 !important;font-size:14px !important;}
  footer .vl-flink:hover{color:#fff !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-grid > .vl-foot-col:last-child{background:#1A1820 !important;border:1px solid #35303c !important;border-left:3px solid #E4002B !important;border-radius:14px !important;padding:16px 18px !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-legallinks button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05) !important;border-color:#3a3542 !important;color:#D7D1C4 !important;}
  @media(max-width:660px){
    footer .vl-foot-grid > .vl-foot-col:last-child{border-top:1px solid #35303c !important;}
    footer .vl-foot-col{border-top:1px solid #2f2b36;}
  }

  /* ===== F7-T3B-R4 · EMPRESAS CO · owner rebalance (hero · consola en tres zonas · cierre · footer) ·
     reglas CO-scoped salvo la capa visual del footer, reabierta por el owner. Sin cambios de logica. ===== */
  /* R4-1 · HERO CO · misma pieza V3, presencia reducida */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia img{aspect-ratio:1/1 !important;}
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.62fr) minmax(0,1fr) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{max-width:400px !important;align-self:start;}
  }
  @media(min-width:661px) and (max-width:1319px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia{width:min(100%,430px) !important;max-width:430px !important;}
  }
  @media(max-width:660px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-heromedia img{aspect-ratio:4/3 !important;} }

  /* R4-2 · CONSOLA · zona B (mapa + inspector) y zona C (01-04) a ancho completo */
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.96fr) minmax(0,1.04fr) !important;background:#fff !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work > .vl-emp-m03{grid-column:1 !important;grid-row:1 !important;position:static !important;top:auto !important;margin:16px !important;min-height:0 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work > .vl-emp-m03 .vl-sec-scene{width:110% !important;max-width:110% !important;margin:0 0 0 -5% !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-split{display:contents !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-split > div:first-child{grid-column:2 !important;grid-row:1 !important;border-left:1px solid #E2DACF !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-ws{grid-column:1 / -1 !important;grid-row:2 !important;border-top:1px solid #E2DACF !important;background:#FBF8F2 !important;}
    /* zona C · 01 + 02 en dos columnas; 03 y 04 a ancho completo */
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:clamp(22px,2.6vw,44px);align-items:start;padding:clamp(20px,2.2vw,30px) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(1){grid-column:1;grid-row:1;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(2){grid-column:1;grid-row:2;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(3){grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 2;margin-top:0 !important;padding:0 0 0 clamp(22px,2.6vw,44px) !important;border-top:none !important;border-left:1px solid #E7E2D6;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(4){grid-column:1 / -1;grid-row:3;margin-top:clamp(18px,2vw,26px) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-act{margin:0 !important;padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) !important;border-radius:0 0 18px 18px !important;}
  }
  /* R4-3 · M03 a escala util tambien en anchos intermedios */
  @media(min-width:721px) and (max-width:1319px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-m03{min-height:clamp(340px,34vw,470px) !important;}
  }

  /* R4-4 · CIERRE · el mockup lidera, la foto acompana */
  @media(min-width:1025px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-cont{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.66fr) minmax(0,1fr) !important;align-items:start !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-cont > figure{align-self:start;justify-self:end;max-width:430px;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-cont > figure img{max-height:min(420px,44vh) !important;}
  }
  @media(max-width:1024px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-cont > figure img{aspect-ratio:16/10 !important;} }

  /* R4-5 · FOOTER · contraste sobre grafito/negro (solo capa visual) */
  footer .vl-foot-col > div:first-child{color:#FFB3BC !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-brand > div:first-child > span:last-child{color:#CFC9BE !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-brand p{color:#E9E4DA !important;}
  footer .vl-flink{color:#FFFFFF !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-legal p{color:#DAD4C9 !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-legal > p:last-child{color:#C7C1B5 !important;}
  footer .vl-foot-legallinks button{color:#F2EEE5 !important;}


  /* ===== F7-T3B-R5 · EMPRESAS CO · copy público de M03/continuidad · jerarquía del inspector ·
     un solo sistema de pasos 01→04. Reglas CO-scoped; GT conserva sus tokens. Sin cambios de lógica. ===== */
  /* R5-1 · M03 · instrucción larga/corta y etiqueta pública acotada */
  .vl-m03-instr-short{display:none;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-m03-kick{max-width:min(56%,320px);line-height:1.35;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-m03-instr,[data-country="co"] .vl-m03-instr-short{white-space:nowrap;}
  @media(max-width:820px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-m03-instr{display:none;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-m03-instr-short{display:block;}
  }

  /* R5-2 · inspector del punto seleccionado · una sola jerarquía */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-spotkick{color:#C4001F !important;font-size:10.5px !important;white-space:nowrap;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-spottitle{font-size:clamp(20px,2.05vw,27px) !important;font-weight:780 !important;line-height:1.08 !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-insp-blk{margin-top:15px !important;border-top:1px solid #E7E2D6 !important;padding-top:13px !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-insp-blk--first{margin-top:18px !important;border-top:2px solid #E4002B !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-insp-lab{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace !important;font-size:10px !important;letter-spacing:.12em !important;color:#6E655C !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-insp-body{font-family:'Instrument Sans',system-ui,sans-serif !important;font-size:14.5px !important;font-weight:400 !important;line-height:1.62 !important;color:#332F28 !important;margin:7px 0 0 !important;max-width:78ch;}
  @media(max-width:660px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-emp-spottitle{font-size:clamp(20px,5.6vw,24px) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-insp-body{font-size:14px !important;}
  }

  /* R5-3 · 01→04 · un solo sistema de encabezado de paso */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-h{display:flex !important;align-items:baseline !important;gap:11px !important;flex-wrap:wrap !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-step-n{flex:0 0 auto;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace !important;font-size:23px !important;font-weight:700 !important;line-height:1 !important;letter-spacing:0 !important;color:#C4001F !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-step-label{font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif !important;font-size:15.5px !important;font-weight:780 !important;letter-spacing:-.005em !important;line-height:1.16 !important;color:#12110F !important;text-transform:none !important;white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto;}
  @media(max-width:420px){ [data-country="co"] .vl-step-label{white-space:normal;} }
  [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-act .vl-step-n{color:#FF7C8C !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-act .vl-step-label{color:#FFFFFF !important;}
  @media(max-width:660px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-step-n{font-size:19px !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-step-label{font-size:13.5px !important;}
  }
  [data-country="gt"] .vl-step-label{text-transform:uppercase;}

  /* R5-4 · zona C · 01 y 02 como superficies independientes; 03 y 04 a ancho completo */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step{min-width:0;}
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-ws{padding:clamp(18px,2vw,26px) !important;gap:clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) !important;column-gap:clamp(18px,2vw,26px) !important;row-gap:clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px) !important;align-items:start !important;padding:0 !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;border-top:none !important;border-radius:0 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(1){grid-column:1 !important;grid-row:1 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(2){grid-column:2 !important;grid-row:1 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-paper > *:nth-child(3){grid-column:1 / -1 !important;grid-row:2 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-step{background:#fff !important;border:1px solid #E7E2D6 !important;border-radius:18px !important;margin:0 !important;padding:clamp(18px,1.9vw,26px) !important;box-shadow:0 20px 44px -40px rgba(30,10,0,.42) !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-work .vl-egt-act{margin:0 !important;border-radius:18px !important;padding:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px) !important;}
  }

  /* ===== F7 CONSOLIDATED TARGETED REPAIR R1 · 2026-09-09 ===== */
  /* REG-02 · shared header: full nav and burger are mutually exclusive at the exact 1320 boundary. */
  @media(min-width:1320px){
    .vl-hdr-full .vl-burger{display:none !important;}
    .vl-hdr-full .vl-util-full{white-space:nowrap !important;flex:0 0 auto !important;min-width:max-content;}
  }

  /* REG-03 · Root mobile: remove the duplicated lower reserve; global Alys is collision-aware below. */
  @media(max-width:659px){
    .vl-screen[data-screen-label="Root"] .vl-root-grid{padding-bottom:clamp(28px,4.4vh,40px) !important;}
  }

  /* REG-04 · Home GT mobile: keep the approved twin, compact only the adjacent breadth explanation. */
  @media(max-width:520px){
    .vl-gt-amplitude{padding:16px !important;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude .vl-v2-dims{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude .vl-v2-dim{border:1px solid #34313d !important;border-radius:11px;padding:10px !important;min-width:0;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude .vl-v2-dim:first-child{border-color:rgba(228,0,43,.72) !important;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude .vl-v2-dim b{font-size:13.5px !important;line-height:1.22;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude .vl-v2-dim i{display:none;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude > p{font-size:12.75px !important;line-height:1.5 !important;margin-top:12px !important;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude > div[style*="display:flex"]{margin-top:13px !important;}
    .vl-gt-amplitude button{min-height:44px !important;font-size:13px !important;padding-left:15px !important;padding-right:15px !important;}
  }

  /* REG-05 · Home CO mobile: flatten only the seven corporate breadth branches; chain/map stays flagship. */
  @media(max-width:620px){
    .vl-co-spine--empresa{padding-left:0 !important;gap:0 !important;border-top:1px solid #34313d;}
    .vl-co-spine--empresa::before{display:none !important;}
    .vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch{
      grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto !important;gap:10px !important;align-items:center !important;
      border:0 !important;border-bottom:1px solid #34313d !important;border-radius:0 !important;
      background:transparent !important;padding:10px 2px !important;min-height:0 !important;box-shadow:none !important;
    }
    .vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch::before,.vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch::after{display:none !important;}
    .vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch em{text-align:right !important;white-space:nowrap !important;font-size:9.5px !important;}
    .vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch i{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.45 !important;}
    .vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch--spec{border-left:2px solid #E4002B !important;padding-left:10px !important;background:rgba(228,0,43,.075) !important;}
  }

  /* REG-06 · functional long-copy floor. Micro labels/eyebrows remain intentionally smaller. */
  @media(max-width:660px){
    .vl-functional-copy{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.55 !important;}
    .vl-co-note{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.5 !important;}
    .vl-co-branch i,.vl-co-stop i,.vl-co-procell i{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.45 !important;}
    .vl-egt-prod > div:last-child{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.48 !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-compnote{font-size:12.5px !important;}
  }

  /* REG-07 · Empresas CO Step03: mobile comparison becomes criterion + explicit A/B columns. */
  @media(max-width:420px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) !important;padding:9px 10px !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-head > span:first-child{display:none !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-head > span:nth-child(2),
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-head > span:nth-child(3){font-size:9.5px !important;letter-spacing:.07em !important;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-data{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) !important;row-gap:8px !important;padding:10px !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-data > span:first-child{grid-column:1 / -1;padding-right:0 !important;font-size:12.75px !important;border-bottom:1px solid #F0EBE0;padding-bottom:7px;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-data > span:nth-child(2),
    [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-data > span:nth-child(3){min-width:0;justify-content:flex-start;}
  }


  /* F7 R1 internal audit hardening · legibility + touch target closure */
  @media(max-width:660px){
    .vl-gt-note,.vl-functional-mobile{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.55 !important;}
    .vl-co-spine--empresa .vl-co-branch .sc-interp{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.45 !important;}
    .vl-co-groups .vl-co-group .sc-interp{font-size:12.5px !important;line-height:1.45 !important;}
    footer .vl-foot-legallinks button{min-height:44px !important;}
  }


  /* F7 R1 final accessibility closure · legal touch targets through tablet. */
  @media(max-width:900px){footer .vl-foot-legallinks button{min-height:44px !important;}}

  /* F7 R1 internal audit hardening · Step03 semantic placeholder contrast */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-data > span:nth-child(2) > span:last-child,
  [data-country="co"] .vl-egt-step--03 .vl-comp-data > span:nth-child(3) > span:last-child{color:#6E655C !important;}

  /* ===== F7 · T4 · Flotillas, transporte y logística (Guatemala) ===== */
  .vl-t4-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:clamp(24px,3.4vw,56px);align-items:center;}
  .vl-t4-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;}
  .vl-t4-sit{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;min-height:64px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease;}
  .vl-t4-map{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.28fr .72fr;gap:clamp(20px,2.6vw,38px);align-items:start;}
  .vl-t4-canvas{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1000/470;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(158deg,#181322 0%,#0B0A0E 66%);border:1px solid #2a2833;}
  .vl-t4-canvas > svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;}
  .vl-t4-node{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;min-height:52px;width:22.5%;min-width:136px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,opacity .14s ease;}
  .vl-t4-nodenum{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;}
  .vl-t4-nodelabel{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:750;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.012em;}
  .vl-t4-nodemeta{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;}
  .vl-t4-narrow{display:none;position:relative;padding-left:26px;}
  .vl-t4-narrow:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:9px;top:14px;bottom:22px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E4002B,rgba(228,0,43,.2));}
  .vl-t4-nnode{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;width:100%;min-height:60px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .vl-t4-nnode:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-22px;top:26px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#E4002B;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #0E0D10;}
  .vl-t4-ledger{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.4fr);gap:10px clamp(18px,3vw,48px);align-items:start;padding:17px 0;border-top:1px solid #E2DACF;}
  .vl-t4-rel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.55fr);gap:12px clamp(16px,2.4vw,40px);align-items:start;padding:17px 0;border-top:1px solid #2a2833;}
  .vl-t4-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;}
  .vl-t4-tag{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.07em;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;}
  .vl-t4-states{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;}
  .vl-t4-method{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(14px,2vw,30px);}
  .vl-t4-node:focus-visible,.vl-t4-sit:focus-visible,.vl-t4-nnode:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FF9DA8;outline-offset:2px;}
  @media(max-width:1024px){ .vl-t4-map{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  @media(max-width:900px){ .vl-t4-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .vl-t4-wide{display:none !important;} .vl-t4-narrow{display:block;} }
  @media(max-width:820px){ .vl-t4-rail{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));} .vl-t4-method{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));} .vl-t4-states{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  @media(max-width:660px){ .vl-t4-ledger,.vl-t4-rel{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px;} .vl-t4-copy{font-size:13.5px !important;line-height:1.6 !important;} }
  @media(max-width:480px){ .vl-t4-rail{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .vl-t4-method{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .vl-t4-node,.vl-t4-sit,.vl-t4-nnode{transition:none !important;} }

  /* ===== F7 · T5 · Transporte / Logística / Cadena · Colombia — aditivo ===== */
  .vl-t5-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.04fr) minmax(420px,.96fr);gap:clamp(30px,3.8vw,64px);align-items:center;}
  .vl-t5-roles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;border-top:1px solid #E2DACF;}
  .vl-t5-role{max-width:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(280px,.82fr) minmax(0,1.28fr);gap:8px clamp(18px,2.4vw,42px);align-items:baseline;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:68px;padding:17px clamp(14px,1.2vw,20px) 17px 2px;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid #E2DACF;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .14s ease,padding-left .14s ease;}
  .vl-t5-role:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
  .vl-t5-canvas{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1000/300;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(168deg,#14121C 0%,#0B0A0E 72%);border:1px solid #2a2833;}
  .vl-t5-canvas > svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;}
  .vl-t5-stage{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;width:17.5%;min-width:126px;min-height:52px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,opacity .14s ease;}
  .vl-t5-stagenum{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;}
  .vl-t5-stagelabel{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:750;font-size:13px;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.012em;}
  .vl-t5-stagemeta{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.35;}
  .vl-t5-narrow{display:none;position:relative;padding-left:26px;}
  .vl-t5-narrow:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:9px;top:14px;bottom:22px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E4002B,rgba(228,0,43,.18));}
  .vl-t5-nstage{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;width:100%;min-height:60px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .vl-t5-nstage:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-22px;top:26px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#E4002B;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #0E0D10;}
  .vl-t5-ins{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 clamp(20px,3vw,52px);}
  .vl-t5-insblock{border-top:1px solid #2a2833;padding:14px 0 16px;min-width:0;}
  .vl-t5-mx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) repeat(5,minmax(0,.6fr));align-items:center;}
  .vl-t5-mxcell{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:48px;border-top:1px solid #2a2833;}
  .vl-t5-mxname{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid #2a2833;min-width:0;}
  .vl-t5-mxnarrow{display:none;}
  .vl-t5-dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;}
  .vl-t5-ctx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 clamp(18px,2.6vw,44px);}
  .vl-t5-ctxitem{border-top:2px solid #C4001F;padding:13px 0 20px;min-width:0;}
  .vl-t5-states{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;}
  .vl-t5-method{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(14px,2vw,30px);}
  .vl-t5-stage:focus-visible,.vl-t5-role:focus-visible,.vl-t5-nstage:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FF9DA8;outline-offset:2px;}
  /* Reserva del rail lateral de Alys: la fila de rol no alcanza la banda derecha del viewport en desktop. */
  @media(min-width:701px){ .vl-t5-role{max-width:none;} }
  @media(max-width:1024px){ .vl-t5-mx{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) repeat(5,minmax(0,.52fr));} }
  @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:901px){ .vl-t5-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(360px,.9fr);gap:30px;} .vl-t5-role{grid-template-columns:36px minmax(220px,.9fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);} }
  @media(max-width:900px){ .vl-t5-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start;} .vl-t5-hero figure{justify-self:stretch;max-width:none !important;} .vl-t5-hero figure img{aspect-ratio:16/10 !important;object-position:56% 50% !important;} .vl-t5-wide{display:none !important;} .vl-t5-narrow{display:block;} .vl-t5-mx{display:none;} .vl-t5-mxnarrow{display:block;} .vl-t5-ins{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  @media(max-width:820px){ .vl-t5-ctx{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));} .vl-t5-method{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));} .vl-t5-states{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  @media(max-width:660px){ .vl-t5-role{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start;} .vl-t5-role > span:nth-child(3){grid-column:2;max-width:none !important;} .vl-t5-ctx{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .vl-t5-copy{font-size:13.5px !important;line-height:1.6 !important;} }
  @media(max-width:480px){ .vl-t5-method{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .vl-t5-stage,.vl-t5-role,.vl-t5-nstage{transition:none !important;} }

  /* REG-01 · Alys safe-rail runtime hook. JS chooses a non-colliding viewport position. */
  .vl-aifab.vl-aifab-safe{transition:left .12s ease,top .12s ease,right .12s ease,bottom .12s ease,opacity .12s ease !important;}

  /* ===== OWNER RW2 · EMPRESAS CO · selector de participación con jerarquía editorial ===== */
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-role{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FBF8F2 0%,#F6F0E6 100%) !important;
    border:1px solid #DED4C6 !important;
    border-top:none !important;
    border-radius:0 0 20px 20px !important;
    padding:clamp(20px,2vw,28px) !important;
    margin:0 0 22px !important;
    box-shadow:0 24px 56px -48px rgba(45,25,0,.55);
  }
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:16px;align-items:start;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-step{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:#E4002B;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 14px 28px -18px rgba(228,0,43,.75);}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-step span{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-kicker{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#C4001F;margin:1px 0 5px;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-copy h3{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.05;margin:0;color:#12110F;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-copy p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;color:#5B544B;margin:8px 0 0;max-width:68ch;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-clear{min-height:44px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #DED4C6;color:#6E655C;font-family:inherit;font-weight:650;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-clear:hover{border-color:#C4001F;color:#C4001F;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-rolechips{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px !important;margin-top:20px !important;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#E4002B !important;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -25px rgba(40,20,0,.55);}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip-n{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#C4001F;align-self:start;padding-top:2px;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip-label{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:750;font-size:13.2px;line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip-arrow{font-size:18px;line-height:1;color:#B7AEA4;transform:translateX(-2px);transition:transform .16s,color .16s;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip:hover .vl-role-chip-arrow{transform:translateX(2px);color:#E4002B;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip[aria-pressed="true"]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;background:#E4002B;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .vl-role-chip-n{color:#FF7C8C;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .vl-role-chip-arrow{color:#fff;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-cue{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #DED4C6;color:#454039;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-cue span{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#C4001F;}
  [data-country="co"] .vl-role-cue strong{font-family:'Archivo';font-size:13px;color:#12110F;}
  @media(max-width:1180px){[data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-rolechips{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));}}
  @media(max-width:760px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-role-head{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-role-clear{grid-column:2;justify-self:start;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-rolechips{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  }
  @media(max-width:520px){
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-role{padding:18px 14px !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-role-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-role-step{width:38px;height:38px;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-role-clear{grid-column:1;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-mapa-rolechips{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px !important;margin-top:16px !important;}
    [data-country="co"] .vl-role-chip{min-height:64px !important;}
  }
</style>

  <!-- REVIEW STRIP (solo ?review=1) -->
  <sc-if value="{{ technicalReview }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
    <div style="background:#0E0D10;color:#EFEAE0;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:7px 22px;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">
      <span style="color:#FF6B7E;">REVIEW/DEV · VISUAL RECONSTRUCTION LOCK</span>
      <span style="color:#ADA69B;">rutas:</span>
      <sc-for list="{{ reviewRoutes }}" as="r" hint-placeholder-count="7"><button onClick="{{ r.go }}" style="background:#211F26;border:1px solid #33323a;color:#cfc9bd;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:10px;">{{ r.label }}</button></sc-for>
    </div>
  </sc-if>

  <!-- ===== HEADER (protagónico, franja blanca continua) ===== -->
  <header style="position:sticky;top:0;z-index:90;background:#FFFFFF;border-bottom:1px solid #E7E2D6;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.02);">
    <div class="vl-hdr-inner {{ hdrMode }}" style="max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,3vw,44px);height:84px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);background:#fff;">
      <button onClick="{{ goRoot }}" aria-label="Inicio · Alianzas y Soluciones" style="background:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;flex-shrink:0;">
        <img class="vl-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Alianzas &amp; Soluciones" style="height:56px;width:auto;display:block;">
      </button>
      <nav class="vl-nav" aria-label="Principal" style="gap:clamp(14px,1.6vw,28px);align-items:center;margin-right:auto;">
        <sc-for list="{{ mainNav }}" as="n" hint-placeholder-count="6"><button onClick="{{ n.go }}" style="{{ n.style }}">{{ n.label }}</button></sc-for>
      </nav>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-left:auto;">
        <button onClick="{{ openHandoffAsist }}" class="vl-asist" aria-label="Necesito asistencia"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 13v-2a8 8 0 0116 0v2"/><path d="M4 13a2 2 0 012-2h1v6H6a2 2 0 01-2-2zM20 13a2 2 0 00-2-2h-1v6h1a2 2 0 002-2z"/><path d="M17 17c0 2-2 3-5 3"/></svg>Necesito asistencia</button>
        <div class="vl-ctrygroup" role="group" aria-label="Seleccionar país" style="display:flex;border:1.5px solid #E7E2D6;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;">
          <button onClick="{{ setGT }}" aria-pressed="{{ isGTsel }}" class="vl-ctry-tab" style="{{ gtTab }}"><span class="vl-ctry-long">Guatemala</span><span class="vl-ctry-short">GT</span></button>
          <button onClick="{{ setCO }}" aria-pressed="{{ isCOsel }}" class="vl-ctry-tab" style="{{ coTab }}"><span class="vl-ctry-long">Colombia</span><span class="vl-ctry-short">CO</span></button>
        </div>
        <button onClick="{{ goCliente }}" class="vl-util-full" style="{{ clienteBtn }}">Soy cliente</button>
        <button onClick="{{ openHandoff }}" data-restore="asesor" class="vl-asesor" aria-label="Hablar con un asesor" style="min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:11px;background:#E4002B;border:none;color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 01-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2z"/></svg>Hablar con un asesor</button>
        <button onClick="{{ toggleMenu }}" data-restore="burger" class="vl-burger" aria-label="Abrir menú" aria-expanded="{{ menuOpen }}" aria-controls="vl-drawer" style="min-width:48px;min-height:48px;border-radius:11px;background:#0E0D10;border:none;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;padding:0;">
          <svg width="20" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M2 2h16M2 8h16M2 14h16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- MOBILE DRAWER -->
  <sc-if value="{{ menuOpen }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
    <div style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:110;background:rgba(14,13,16,.55);" onClick="{{ toggleMenu }}"></div>
    <div id="vl-drawer" data-drawer role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Navegación" style="position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:111;width:min(88vw,360px);background:#0E0D10;color:#EFEAE0;padding:22px;overflow:auto;animation:vl-rise .3s ease both;">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <span style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:#ADA69B;">{{ menuTitle }}</span>
        <button onClick="{{ toggleMenu }}" aria-label="Cerrar" style="background:none;border:none;color:#EFEAE0;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;">×</button>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">
        <sc-for list="{{ drawerNav }}" as="n" hint-placeholder-count="6"><button onClick="{{ n.go }}" style="text-align:left;min-height:52px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:#1A1820;border:1px solid #2a2833;color:#EFEAE0;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;">{{ n.label }}</button></sc-for>
      </div>
      <sc-if value="{{ countryPromptOpen }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
        <div style="margin-top:16px;padding:16px;border-radius:14px;background:#17151A;border:1px solid #33323a;">
          <div style="font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:#F4F1EA;">Elige tu país para continuar</div>
          <p style="font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;color:#ADA69B;margin:8px 0 12px;">Esta sección depende del país: sus servicios y canales varían entre Guatemala y Colombia.</p>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
            <button onClick="{{ countryPromptGT }}" style="flex:1;min-height:46px;border-radius:11px;border:none;background:#E4002B;color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;">Guatemala</button>
            <button onClick="{{ countryPromptCO }}" style="flex:1;min-height:46px;border-radius:11px;border:none;background:#E4002B;color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;">Colombia</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </sc-if>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:18px;">
        <button onClick="{{ setGT }}" aria-pressed="{{ isGTsel }}" style="{{ gtTabM }}">Guatemala</button>
        <button onClick="{{ setCO }}" aria-pressed="{{ isCOsel }}" style="{{ coTabM }}">Colombia</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </sc-if>

  <main id="vl-main" tabindex="-1" style="outline:none;">
  <sc-if value="{{ showBack }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
    <div style="background:#0E0D10;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);"><div style="max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto;padding:8px clamp(20px,3vw,44px);"><button onClick="{{ goBack }}" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 6px;background:none;border:none;color:#EFEAE0;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6"/></svg>Volver</button></div></div>
  </sc-if>

  <!-- ============================ ROOT · M01 hero editorial + capa de sistema ============================ -->
  <sc-if value="{{ isRoot }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ true }}">
    <section class="vl-screen" data-screen-label="Root" style="position:relative;background:#0E0D10;color:#F4F1EA;min-height:calc(100vh - 84px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;">
      <div aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(1100px 640px at 80% 8%,rgba(228,0,43,.16),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(760px 600px at 4% 96%,rgba(123,0,22,.24),transparent 62%);"></div>
      <div aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.55;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:58px 58px;mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 72% 42%,#000,transparent 72%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 72% 42%,#000,transparent 72%);"></div>
      <div class="vl-root-grid" style="position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;padding:clamp(28px,4.4vh,58px) clamp(20px,3vw,44px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.06fr;gap:clamp(26px,3.4vw,54px);align-items:start;flex:1;">
        <div>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#FF7C8C;">
            <span style="width:34px;height:2px;background:#E4002B;"></span> A&amp;S · Guatemala + Colombia
          </div>
          <h1 style="font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(46px,6.2vw,96px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:22px 0 0;text-wrap:balance;max-width:13ch;">Del riesgo a la <span style="color:#FF3B54;">decisión.</span></h1>
          <p style="font-family:'Instrument Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(18px,1.85vw,25px);line-height:1.45;color:#D7D1C4;margin:20px 0 0;max-width:45ch;">A&amp;S acompaña a empresas, personas y familias en Guatemala y Colombia. Selecciona tu país para ver las soluciones, servicios y canales disponibles en ese mercado.</p>
          <p style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#EDE7DA;margin:30px 0 0;"><span aria-hidden="true" style="width:22px;height:2px;background:#E4002B;flex:none;"></span>Elige dónde quieres continuar.</p>
          <div class="vl-root-ctry" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;max-width:620px;margin-top:14px;">
            <button onClick="{{ chooseGT }}" aria-label="Continuar en Guatemala" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 18px;min-height:108px;transition:all .2s;" style-hover="border-color:#E4002B;background:rgba(228,0,43,.14);transform:translateY(-3px);" style-focus="outline:2px solid #FF7C8C;outline-offset:3px;">
              <span style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;min-width:0;">
                <span style="font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(17px,1.25vw,20.5px);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#fff;">Continuar en Guatemala</span>
                <span style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#C6BFB1;">Soluciones, servicios y canales disponibles en Guatemala.</span>
              </span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" style="flex:none;margin-left:auto;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#E4002B;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:16px;">→</span>
            </button>
            <button onClick="{{ chooseCO }}" aria-label="Continuar en Colombia" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 18px;min-height:108px;transition:all .2s;" style-hover="border-color:#E4002B;background:rgba(228,0,43,.14);transform:translateY(-3px);" style-focus="outline:2px solid #FF7C8C;outline-offset:3px;">
              <span style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;min-width:0;">
                <span style="font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(17px,1.25vw,20.5px);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#fff;">Continuar en Colombia</span>
                <span style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#C6BFB1;">Soluciones, servicios y canales disponibles en Colombia.</span>
              </span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" style="flex:none;margin-left:auto;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#E4002B;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:16px;">→</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <p style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#9E978A;margin:26px 0 0;max-width:60ch;">La operación, regulación, productos, aseguradoras, canales y capacidades digitales pueden variar por país.</p>
        </div>
        <!-- right: framed team mosaic + capa digital de criterio -->
        <div class="vl-root-media" style="position:relative;">
          <figure style="margin:0;position:relative;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/10;background:#0E0D10;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 50px 100px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.85),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);">
            <img src="assets/photos/01_ROOT_TEAM_WITH_PRISCILA_APPROVED_20260921.png" alt="Composición visual del equipo A&amp;S para la portada" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center center;display:block;">
            <div aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(14,13,16,.55),transparent 44%);"></div>
            
          </figure>
